fusions.name: Seared Tongue
fusions.desc: Speaks a searing word at one enemy within 7 tiles that deals 10 damage, stuns it for 0.8 seconds and silences it for 3 seconds, taking its next action away.

fusions.name: Practiced Incantation
fusions.desc: A spoken bolt of fire that deals 28 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its full 8-tile reach, and sets the target [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Recited Reach
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to recite, then your attacks and spells reach 40% further for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Rote Learned
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. You have 8% fire resistance.
